metadata.name: bills
metadata.comment: Business-facing bills view. One row per current MYOB AP bill line. Enriched with supplier name, class, and ABN; and MYOB project name, status, and branch. Use project_id + cost_code to match against project_margin_detail for drill-down reconciliation. estimated_allowance_value is the approved budget allowance for that cost code within the project. Exposed to Metabase and NLQ.

bill_status.name: bill_status
bill_status.comment: Current bill status in MYOB (e.g. Open, Closed).

is_open.name: is_open
is_open.comment: True if the bill is currently open (not yet fully paid).

vendor_id.name: vendor_id
vendor_id.comment: MYOB vendor identifier. Join to suppliers.vendor_id.

closed_date.name: closed_date
closed_date.comment: Date the bill was closed or paid. Null if still open.

pay_date.name: pay_date
pay_date.comment: Actual payment date. Null if unpaid.

post_period.name: post_period
post_period.comment: MYOB accounting period the bill was posted to.

project_id.name: project_id
project_id.comment: MYOB project this bill line is assigned to. Join to project_margins.project_id.

project_status.name: project_status
project_status.comment: Current status of the linked MYOB project.

project_branch.name: project_branch
project_branch.comment: MYOB branch of the linked project.

cost_code.name: cost_code
cost_code.comment: Cost code within the project. Matches cost_code in project_margin_detail.

balance.name: balance
balance.comment: Outstanding balance on this bill line in AUD.

estimated_allowance_value.name: estimated_allowance_value
estimated_allowance_value.comment: Budgeted/approved cost allowance for this project + cost code in AUD. Represents the contingency or trade allowance set on the project bill.

last_modified_on.name: last_modified_on
last_modified_on.comment: Timestamp of last modification in MYOB.

has_stats.label: Has Stats?
has_stats.description: Indicates whether there are statistics for this table

metadata.name: project_transactions
metadata.comment: Business-facing project transactions view. One row per MYOB project GL transaction line. Raw financial transactions underlying project_margins. Unlike project_margins, this includes WIP and WIPINC entries. amounts are raw GL values — negative = credit/income. Apply abs() when calculating revenue for SALES/COGS4 groups. Exposed to Metabase and NLQ.

project_id.name: project_id
project_id.comment: MYOB project identifier. Join to project_margins.project_id.

project_branch.name: project_branch
project_branch.comment: MYOB branch code for the project.

project_task.name: project_task
project_task.comment: MYOB project task code this transaction is posted against.

ref_nbr.name: ref_nbr
ref_nbr.comment: Originating reference number (e.g. invoice or bill number) that generated this transaction.

module.name: module
module.comment: MYOB module that originated the transaction (AR = accounts receivable, AP = accounts payable, GL = general ledger).

account_group.name: account_group
account_group.comment: GL account group. SALES/COGS4 = income; COGS/EXP1/EXADVERT/EXFRE/EXGEN/EXOFFICE/EXTRAVEL/EXPOTH1 = costs; WIP/WIPINC = work-in-progress.

customer_vendor.name: customer_vendor
customer_vendor.comment: Customer or vendor identifier. Prefix C or 2 = customer (join to customers.customer_id); prefix S = supplier (join to suppliers.vendor_id).

created_date.name: created_date
created_date.comment: Date the transaction record was created in MYOB.

amount.name: amount
amount.comment: GL transaction amount in AUD. Negative values are credits/income. Apply abs() for SALES/COGS4 when calculating revenue.

uom.name: uom
uom.comment: Unit of measure for the quantity.

description_3.name: description_3
description_3.comment: Tertiary description. Cleaned version (carriage returns collapsed) is in project_margin_detail.description.

billable.name: billable
billable.comment: True if this transaction is billable to the client.

billed.name: billed
billed.comment: True if this transaction has already been billed.

released.name: released
released.comment: True if this transaction has been released for billing.

tran_amount.name: tran_amount
tran_amount.comment: Project module transaction amount (pm_tran_amount) in AUD.

has_stats.label: Has Stats?
has_stats.description: Indicates whether there are statistics for this table

metadata.name: accounts
metadata.comment: Business-facing accounts view. Pass-through of ops_accounts. One row per active Tracker account (client company). Exposed to Metabase and NLQ. Do not query ops_accounts directly.

account_sk.name: account_sk
account_sk.comment: Surrogate key (md5 of account_id). Use account_id for joins.

account_name.name: account_name
account_name.comment: Client company name, title-cased and trimmed.

account_type.name: account_type
account_type.comment: Account classification from Tracker (e.g. volume builder, designer, commercial).

account_description.name: account_description
account_description.comment: General notes from the Tracker General Note field.

primary_phone.name: primary_phone
primary_phone.comment: Primary contact phone number, zero-padded to 10 digits.

myob_customer_id.name: myob_customer_id
myob_customer_id.comment: Linked MYOB customer identifier. Join to customers.customer_id for financial data.

volume_builder_id_portal.name: volume_builder_id_portal
volume_builder_id_portal.comment: Volume builder identifier from the Portal system.

src_created_at.name: src_created_at
src_created_at.comment: Timestamp when the record was created in Tracker.

src_updated_at.name: src_updated_at
src_updated_at.comment: Timestamp of the last update in Tracker.

has_stats.label: Has Stats?
has_stats.description: Indicates whether there are statistics for this table

metadata.name: callouts
metadata.comment: Business-facing callouts view. Pass-through of ops_callouts. One row per Tracker callout (including cancelled, excluding soft-deleted). Exposed to Metabase and NLQ. Do not query ops_callouts directly.

id.name: id
id.comment: Tracker internal callout identifier (Knack record ID).

callout_id.name: callout_id
callout_id.comment: Tracker source record identifier (human-readable callout reference).

created_date.name: created_date
created_date.comment: Date the callout was created in Tracker.

callout.name: callout
callout.comment: Display name of the callout form in Tracker.

business_unit.name: business_unit
business_unit.comment: Business unit associated with the callout.

state.name: state
state.comment: Australian state of the callout location.

status.name: status
status.comment: Current callout status (e.g. Confirmed, Tentative, Cancelled, Completed).

outcome.name: outcome
outcome.comment: Outcome recorded after the callout was completed.

is_rescheduled.name: is_rescheduled
is_rescheduled.comment: True if this callout has been rescheduled from an earlier appointment.

is_future.name: is_future
is_future.comment: True if the callout is scheduled in the future relative to processing time.

priority.name: priority
priority.comment: Booking priority label (HTML stripped from source value).

installer_report.name: installer_report
installer_report.comment: Report notes submitted by the installer after the callout.

has_stats.description: Indicates whether there are statistics for this table

metadata.name: contacts
metadata.comment: Business-facing contacts view. Pass-through of ops_contacts. One row per active Tracker contact. Exposed to Metabase and NLQ. Do not query ops_contacts directly.

display_name.name: display_name
display_name.comment: Contact display name as shown in Tracker.

contact_description.name: contact_description
contact_description.comment: General notes from the Tracker General Note field.

email_label.name: email_label
email_label.comment: Email label or type from Tracker.

no_email.name: no_email
no_email.comment: True if the contact has opted out of email communications.

no_phone.name: no_phone
no_phone.comment: True if the contact has opted out of phone contact.

src_created_at.name: src_created_at
src_created_at.comment: Timestamp when the contact was created in Tracker.

src_updated_at.name: src_updated_at
src_updated_at.comment: Timestamp of the last update in Tracker.

has_stats.description: Indicates whether there are statistics for this table

metadata.name: installers
metadata.comment: Business-facing installers view. Pass-through of ops_installers. One row per active Tracker installer (contractor), excluding test records. Exposed to Metabase and NLQ. Do not query ops_installers directly.

is_subcontractor.name: is_subcontractor
is_subcontractor.comment: True if the installer is a subcontractor; false for Lovelight employees.

hex_display_color_code.name: hex_display_color_code
hex_display_color_code.comment: Hex colour code used to identify this installer on the Tracker calendar.

hd_delivery_code.name: hd_delivery_code
hd_delivery_code.comment: Delivery code for the HD system.

get_tentative_invite.name: get_tentative_invite
get_tentative_invite.comment: True if this installer receives tentative booking invites.

is_custom.name: is_custom
is_custom.comment: True if this installer is associated with the Custom business unit.

src_created_at.name: src_created_at
src_created_at.comment: Timestamp when the installer record was created in Tracker.

src_updated_at.name: src_updated_at
src_updated_at.comment: Timestamp of the last update in Tracker.

metadata.name: invoices
metadata.comment: Business-facing invoices view. One row per MYOB invoice. MYOB is the financial source of truth. Tracker provides operational context (job, business unit, state, sales/ops email) for invoices that originated in Tracker. Columns from Tracker are null for MYOB-only invoices. Exposed to Metabase and NLQ.

invoice_number.name: invoice_number
invoice_number.comment: MYOB invoice number. Primary identifier and join key.

type.name: type
type.comment: Invoice type from MYOB (e.g. Tax Invoice, Credit Note).

value_ex_gst.name: value_ex_gst
value_ex_gst.comment: Invoice value excluding GST in AUD.

inc_gst_amount.name: inc_gst_amount
inc_gst_amount.comment: Invoice value including GST in AUD.

amount_due.name: amount_due
amount_due.comment: Outstanding amount in AUD. Zero when fully paid.

status.name: status
status.comment: Current MYOB invoice status (e.g. Open, Closed, Voided).

invoice_date.name: invoice_date
invoice_date.comment: Date the invoice was raised in MYOB.

closed_date.name: closed_date
closed_date.comment: Date the invoice was closed or paid.

created_date.name: created_date
created_date.comment: Date the invoice record was created in MYOB.

customer.name: customer
customer.comment: MYOB customer identifier. Join to customers.customer_id.

state.name: state
state.comment: Australian state as recorded in MYOB.

last_modified_on.name: last_modified_on
last_modified_on.comment: Timestamp of last modification in MYOB.

myob_project.name: myob_project
myob_project.comment: MYOB project linked to this invoice.

tracker_invoice_id.name: tracker_invoice_id
tracker_invoice_id.comment: Tracker invoice identifier. Null for invoices not originating in Tracker.

job.name: job
job.comment: Tracker job reference linked to this invoice (e.g. VA12345). Null for MYOB-only invoices.

business_unit.name: business_unit
business_unit.comment: Tracker business unit (e.g. Projects, Apartments, Custom). Null for MYOB-only invoices.

is_paid.name: is_paid
is_paid.comment: Whether the invoice has been marked paid in Tracker.

issue_date.name: issue_date
issue_date.comment: Date the invoice was issued in Tracker.

paid_date.name: paid_date
paid_date.comment: Date the invoice was marked paid in Tracker.

sales_email.name: sales_email
sales_email.comment: Email of the salesperson responsible. Null for MYOB-only invoices.

ops_email.name: ops_email
ops_email.comment: Email of the ops person responsible. Null for MYOB-only invoices.

has_stats.label: Has Stats?
has_stats.description: Indicates whether there are statistics for this table

metadata.name: invoices_reporting
metadata.comment: Business-facing invoice reconciliation view. One row per Tracker invoice that has been exported to MYOB or Xero. Enriches Tracker operational context (from ops_invoices) with MYOB financial data (from fin_invoices) and Xero data (direct reference, pre-April 2023). Includes division/state match flags for reconciliation. Exposed to Metabase and NLQ.

report_date.name: report_date
report_date.comment: Effective reporting date. Prioritises MYOB invoice date, then Xero date, then Tracker issue date. Use this for financial month reporting.

system_report_date.name: system_report_date
system_report_date.comment: Date the invoice was issued in Tracker (the operational date).

month_match.name: month_match
month_match.comment: True if the MYOB/Xero invoice date falls in the same calendar month as the Tracker issue date. False indicates a period mismatch that may affect monthly totals.

created_date.name: created_date
created_date.comment: Date the invoice was created in Tracker.

value_ex_gst.name: value_ex_gst
value_ex_gst.comment: Invoice value excluding GST in AUD. Sourced from MYOB, then Xero, then Tracker in priority order.

system_invoice_number.name: system_invoice_number
system_invoice_number.comment: Combined MYOB reference number or Xero invoice ID used for cross-system matching.

business_unit.name: business_unit
business_unit.comment: Tracker business unit (e.g. Projects, Apartments, Custom).

myob_division.name: myob_division
myob_division.comment: Division as recorded in MYOB. Compare with division to identify mismatches.

division_match.name: division_match
division_match.comment: True if the Tracker and MYOB division values match.

myob_state.name: myob_state
myob_state.comment: State as recorded in MYOB. Compare with state to identify mismatches.

state_match.name: state_match
state_match.comment: True if the Tracker and MYOB state values match.

ops_email.name: ops_email
ops_email.comment: Email of the ops person responsible.

has_stats.label: Has Stats?
has_stats.description: Indicates whether there are statistics for this table

metadata.name: jobs
metadata.comment: Business-facing jobs view. Pass-through of ops_jobs. One row per active (non-cancelled) Tracker job. Exposed to Metabase and NLQ. Do not query ops_jobs directly.

id.name: id
id.comment: Tracker internal job identifier (Knack record ID).

src_sys_id.name: src_sys_id
src_sys_id.comment: Tracker source record identifier (human-readable job reference, e.g. VA12345).

business_unit.name: business_unit
business_unit.comment: Business unit (e.g. Custom, SWP, Residential, Projects, Apartments).

apt.name: apt
apt.comment: Apartment reference for apartment business unit jobs.

status_change_date.name: status_change_date
status_change_date.comment: Date the job status last changed.

value_ex_gst.name: value_ex_gst
value_ex_gst.comment: Job sale value excluding GST in AUD.

is_exempt.name: is_exempt
is_exempt.comment: True if this job is exempt from invoicing and sales tracking.

invoiced.name: invoiced
invoiced.comment: Total amount invoiced against this job in AUD.

scheduled.name: scheduled
scheduled.comment: Total amount scheduled for invoicing (not yet invoiced) in AUD.

missing.name: missing
missing.comment: Job value not yet scheduled or invoiced in AUD.

created_date.name: created_date
created_date.comment: Date the job was created in Tracker.

salesperson.name: salesperson
salesperson.comment: Name of the salesperson responsible for this job.

salesperson_myob_id.name: salesperson_myob_id
salesperson_myob_id.comment: MYOB identifier of the salesperson. Use for cross-system joins to MYOB records.

is_reported_sale.name: is_reported_sale
is_reported_sale.comment: True if this job is included in reported sales figures.

myob_project_id.name: myob_project_id
myob_project_id.comment: Linked MYOB project identifier. Join to project_margins.project_id.

completed_date.name: completed_date
completed_date.comment: Date the job was first marked complete in Tracker.

job_name_prefix.name: job_name_prefix
job_name_prefix.comment: Prefix component of the job name (e.g. VA, SWP).

job_reference_with_development.name: job_reference_with_development
job_reference_with_development.comment: Job reference including development name where applicable.

quoterite_job_id.name: quoterite_job_id
quoterite_job_id.comment: Linked QuoteRite order identifier. Null for Tracker-standalone jobs.

ops_person.name: ops_person
ops_person.comment: Name of the ops person assigned to this job.

ops_person_email.name: ops_person_email
ops_person_email.comment: Email of the ops person assigned.

has_stats.label: Has Stats?
has_stats.description: Indicates whether there are statistics for this table

metadata.name: leads
metadata.comment: Business-facing leads view. Pass-through of ops_leads. One row per lead from Portal and Capture. Currently returns no rows — pending Portal and Capture pipeline onboarding. Exposed to Metabase and NLQ. Do not query ops_leads directly.

lead_sk.name: lead_sk
lead_sk.comment: Surrogate key (null — stub; will populate once portal/capture pipelines are onboarded).

src_sys_cd.name: src_sys_cd
src_sys_cd.comment: Source system (null — stub; will be PORTAL or CAPTURE once live).

value_ex_gst.name: value_ex_gst
value_ex_gst.comment: Lead value excluding GST in AUD (null — stub).

lost_reason.name: lost_reason
lost_reason.comment: Reason the lead was lost (null — stub).

has_stats.description: Indicates whether there are statistics for this table

metadata.name: opportunities
metadata.comment: Business-facing opportunities view. Pass-through of ops_opportunities. One row per Tracker opportunity. Exposed to Metabase and NLQ. Do not query ops_opportunities directly.

id.name: id
id.comment: Tracker internal opportunity identifier (Knack record ID).

is_reported_sale.name: is_reported_sale
is_reported_sale.comment: True if this opportunity is included in reported sales figures.

quote_number.name: quote_number
quote_number.comment: Quote number. Used as the opportunity identifier in sales reporting.

ops_id.name: ops_id
ops_id.comment: Tracker identifier of the ops person assigned.

ops_name.name: ops_name
ops_name.comment: Name of the ops person assigned.

status.name: status
status.comment: Opportunity status (e.g. Won, Lost, Active, Quoted).

date_created.name: date_created
date_created.comment: Date the opportunity was created in Tracker.

value_ex_gst.name: value_ex_gst
value_ex_gst.comment: Opportunity value excluding GST in AUD.

date_quoted.name: date_quoted
date_quoted.comment: Date the quote was issued to the client.

date_closed.name: date_closed
date_closed.comment: Date the opportunity was won or lost.

tender.name: tender
tender.comment: Tender reference if this is a tender submission.

quote_due_date.name: quote_due_date
quote_due_date.comment: Date the quote is due to the client.

estimated_hours_to_quote.name: estimated_hours_to_quote
estimated_hours_to_quote.comment: Estimated hours to complete the quotation.

date_submitted_for_review.name: date_submitted_for_review
date_submitted_for_review.comment: Date the quote was submitted for internal review.

date_approved.name: date_approved
date_approved.comment: Date the quote was approved internally.

commission_rebate_payable.name: commission_rebate_payable
commission_rebate_payable.comment: Commission or rebate payable on this opportunity.

requote.name: requote
requote.comment: True if this is a re-quote of a previous opportunity (legacy field; see also is_requote).

actual_hours_to_quote.name: actual_hours_to_quote
actual_hours_to_quote.comment: Actual hours spent on the quotation.

remaining_hours.name: remaining_hours
remaining_hours.comment: Remaining hours budgeted for the quotation.

total_blinds_quoted.name: total_blinds_quoted
total_blinds_quoted.comment: Total number of blinds quoted on this opportunity.

total_curtains_quoted.name: total_curtains_quoted
total_curtains_quoted.comment: Total number of curtains quoted on this opportunity.

likelihood.name: likelihood
likelihood.comment: Probability score (0-100) for winning this opportunity.

expected_close_date.name: expected_close_date
expected_close_date.comment: Expected date the opportunity will close (won or lost).

invoicing_structure.name: invoicing_structure
invoicing_structure.comment: Invoicing structure agreed for this opportunity (e.g. milestone-based, on-completion).

project_duration.name: project_duration
project_duration.comment: Expected duration of the project in weeks.

is_swp.name: is_swp
is_swp.comment: True if this is a SWP (Supply and Install) opportunity.

forecast_swp_conversion_rate.name: forecast_swp_conversion_rate
forecast_swp_conversion_rate.comment: Forecast SWP conversion rate (proportion expected to convert to won).

date_forecast_updated.name: date_forecast_updated
date_forecast_updated.comment: Date the forecast figures were last updated.

expected_value.name: expected_value
expected_value.comment: Expected deal value accounting for likelihood (may differ from value_ex_gst).

volume_builder_po_number.name: volume_builder_po_number
volume_builder_po_number.comment: Volume builder purchase order number from Portal.

is_requote.name: is_requote
is_requote.comment: True if this is a re-quote of a previous opportunity.

has_stats.label: Has Stats?
has_stats.description: Indicates whether there are statistics for this table

metadata.name: project_margins
metadata.comment: Business-facing project margins view. One row per MYOB project. Aggregates GL transaction lines from fin_project_transactions (excluding WIP/WIPINC) into revenue, costs, and margin. Joined with Tracker/Portal ownership from ops_project_owner. Ownership columns are null for projects with no matching Tracker or Portal record. Exposed to Metabase and NLQ.

bill_complete_date.name: bill_complete_date
bill_complete_date.comment: Date billing was marked complete in MYOB. When set, WIP has been recognised — revenue and costs here are final recognised figures.

status.name: status
status.comment: Current MYOB project status (e.g. Active, Completed, Cancelled).

job.name: job
job.comment: Tracker or Portal job number linked to this project. Null if no ownership record found.

owner_email.name: owner_email
owner_email.comment: Email of the salesperson who owns this project. Resolved via ops_project_owner priority rules.

business_unit.name: business_unit
business_unit.comment: Business unit derived from MYOB invoice division (Volume, Custom, Commercial, Retail, Online). Falls back to Tracker business_unit for projects with no MYOB invoice division (e.g. Apartments, Displays). Null if neither source has a value.

state.name: state
state.comment: Australian state derived from MYOB invoice line item branch codes (same logic as fin_invoices). Falls back to Tracker project state if no matching line item branch found. Null if neither source has state data.

expected_margin.name: expected_margin
expected_margin.comment: Budgeted margin percentage set on the MYOB project.

revenue.name: revenue
revenue.comment: Recognised income in AUD. abs(sum of SALES + COGS4 account groups). COGS4 is treated as income — pass-through charges billed to clients. Zero if no recognised transactions.

total_costs.name: total_costs
total_costs.comment: Total project costs in AUD. Sum of COGS, EXP1, EXADVERT, EXFRE, EXGEN, EXOFFICE, EXTRAVEL, EXPOTH1 account groups. WIP/WIPINC excluded.

exadvert.name: exadvert
exadvert.comment: Advertising costs (EXADVERT account group) broken out separately. Subset of total_costs.

gross_margin.name: gross_margin
gross_margin.comment: Revenue minus total_costs. Positive = profitable project. Negative = project running at a loss.

gross_margin_pct.name: gross_margin_pct
gross_margin_pct.comment: Gross margin as a percentage of revenue, rounded to 4 decimal places. Null when revenue is zero.

owner_name.name: owner_name
owner_name.comment: Full name of the owning salesperson. Null for Portal-sourced ownership records.

ownership_source.name: ownership_source
ownership_source.comment: Which record resolved ownership: tracker_custom_job, tracker_job_via_project, tracker_project, tracker_standalone_job, or portal_job.

total_bill_allowance.name: total_bill_allowance
total_bill_allowance.comment: Sum of estimated bill allowances across all cost codes for this project. Sourced from fin_bills.estimated_allowance_value.

has_stats.label: Has Stats?
has_stats.description: Indicates whether there are statistics for this table

metadata.name: projects
metadata.comment: Business-facing projects view. Pass-through of ops_projects. One row per active Tracker project, enriched with MYOB project metadata. Exposed to Metabase and NLQ. Do not query ops_projects directly.

project_id.name: project_id
project_id.comment: Tracker internal project identifier (Knack record ID).

project_name_with_id.name: project_name_with_id
project_name_with_id.comment: Project name concatenated with the project ID for display in reports.

prefixed_id.name: prefixed_id
prefixed_id.comment: Project identifier with prefix (e.g. P001234). Primary reference used in sales reporting.

project_type.name: project_type
project_type.comment: Project type category (e.g. Direct, Volume Builder).

project_status_sort_order.name: project_status_sort_order
project_status_sort_order.comment: Numeric sort order for project status values.

construction_status_sort_order.name: construction_status_sort_order
construction_status_sort_order.comment: Numeric sort order for construction status values.

sales_and_ops_team.name: sales_and_ops_team
sales_and_ops_team.comment: Combined sales and ops team assignment.

have_formal_contract.name: have_formal_contract
have_formal_contract.comment: True if a formal contract has been executed for this project.

project_folder_url.name: project_folder_url
project_folder_url.comment: URL to the project folder in the document management system.

website_development_id.name: website_development_id
website_development_id.comment: Development identifier from the website or portal.

myob_project_reference.name: myob_project_reference
myob_project_reference.comment: MYOB project reference linked to this Tracker project. Join to project_margins.project_id.

myob_project_status.name: myob_project_status
myob_project_status.comment: Current MYOB project status corresponding to this Tracker project.

myob_customer.name: myob_customer
myob_customer.comment: MYOB customer linked to this project.

myob_branch.name: myob_branch
myob_branch.comment: MYOB branch of the linked project.

contract_type.name: contract_type
contract_type.comment: Type of contract (e.g. fixed price, time and materials).

expected_margin.name: expected_margin
expected_margin.comment: Budgeted margin percentage set on the project.

date_first_marked_compete.name: date_first_marked_compete
date_first_marked_compete.comment: Date the project was first marked complete in Tracker.

ll_status_display.name: ll_status_display
ll_status_display.comment: Lovelight status display label derived from Tracker status for reporting purposes.

src_created_at.name: src_created_at
src_created_at.comment: Timestamp when the project was created in Tracker.

src_updated_at.name: src_updated_at
src_updated_at.comment: Timestamp of the last update in Tracker.

has_stats.label: Has Stats?
has_stats.description: Indicates whether there are statistics for this table

metadata.name: sales
metadata.comment: Business-facing sales view. One row per sale combining Tracker project opportunities (Direct, won), Tracker jobs (with and without QuoteRite IDs), and QuoteRite-only orders (from 2024-11-01). Sources: ops_opportunities + ops_projects for project sales; ops_jobs for job sales; quoterite_dim_order + quoterite_fct_order for QR-only orders. Exposed to Metabase and NLQ.

date.name: date
date.comment: Sale date. Opportunity close date for projects; job created date for custom jobs; order created date for QuoteRite-only orders.

completed_date.name: completed_date
completed_date.comment: Date the project or job was first marked complete. Null for QuoteRite-only orders.

id.name: id
id.comment: Unique sale identifier. Format varies by source — {project_prefix}-{quote_number} for projects; {job_prefix}{src_id} for Tracker jobs; order_unique_id for QuoteRite-only orders.

name.name: name
name.comment: Sale name. Opportunity name for projects; job reference with development for custom jobs; order sidemark for QuoteRite-only orders.

project.name: project
project.comment: Project or job name. Project name with ID for projects; job name for custom jobs; order sidemark for QuoteRite-only orders.

salesperson.name: salesperson
salesperson.comment: Name of the salesperson who made the sale.

opsperson.name: opsperson
opsperson.comment: Name of the ops person assigned. Null for QuoteRite-only orders.

value.name: value
value.comment: Sale value excluding GST in AUD.

designer_commissions.name: designer_commissions
designer_commissions.comment: Designer commission amount in AUD. Zero for project sales and QuoteRite-only orders.

is_active_sales.name: is_active_sales
is_active_sales.comment: True if this sale is included in active sales reporting. Based on is_reported_sale in Tracker or QuoteRite.

division.name: division
division.comment: Commercial for project-linked sales; Custom for Tracker jobs and QuoteRite-only orders.

business_unit.name: business_unit
business_unit.comment: Business unit of the sale (Projects, Apartments, Custom, or other Tracker business unit).

state.name: state
state.comment: Australian state of the sale (VIC, NSW, QLD, etc.). State-mapped from sales rep name for QuoteRite-only orders.

has_stats.label: Has Stats?
has_stats.description: Indicates whether there are statistics for this table

metadata.name: customers
metadata.comment: Business-facing customers view. One row per MYOB customer. Source of truth for client financial identities in MYOB. Use customer_id to join against invoices (invoices.customer) or project_transactions. Exposed to Metabase and NLQ.

customer_id.name: customer_id
customer_id.comment: MYOB customer identifier. Primary join key.

customer_name.name: customer_name
customer_name.comment: Customer company or individual name in MYOB.

customer_status.name: customer_status
customer_status.comment: Customer status in MYOB (e.g. Active, Inactive).

last_modified_on.name: last_modified_on
last_modified_on.comment: Timestamp of last modification in MYOB.

created_on.name: created_on
created_on.comment: Timestamp when the customer record was created in MYOB.

has_stats.label: Has Stats?
has_stats.description: Indicates whether there are statistics for this table

metadata.name: project_margin_detail
metadata.comment: Transaction-level drill-down companion to project_margins. One row per MYOB project transaction line (WIP/WIPINC excluded). Shows every individual GL posting behind a project margin figure — cost code, account group, amount, and the estimated bill allowance for that cost code. Join to project_margins on project_id for the aggregated summary. account_name resolves to customer name (prefix C/2) or supplier name (prefix S) from the customer_vendor field.

bill_complete_date.name: bill_complete_date
bill_complete_date.comment: Date billing was marked complete in MYOB. When set, transactions here are recognised revenue and costs.

job.name: job
job.comment: Tracker or Portal job number linked to this project.

project_id.name: project_id
project_id.comment: MYOB project identifier. Join key to project_margins.

owner.name: owner
owner.comment: Email of the salesperson who owns this project.

business_unit.name: business_unit
business_unit.comment: Business unit derived from MYOB invoice division (Volume, Custom, Commercial, Retail, Online). Falls back to Tracker business_unit for projects with no MYOB invoice division (e.g. Apartments, Displays). Null if neither source has a value.

state.name: state
state.comment: Australian state derived from MYOB invoice line item branch codes (same logic as fin_invoices). Falls back to Tracker project state if no matching line item branch found. Null if neither source has state data.

tran_id.name: tran_id
tran_id.comment: MYOB transaction identifier. Unique per transaction line.

ref_nbr.name: ref_nbr
ref_nbr.comment: Originating reference number (e.g. invoice or bill number) that generated this transaction.

module.name: module
module.comment: MYOB module that originated the transaction (e.g. AR, AP, GL).

created_date.name: created_date
created_date.comment: Date the transaction record was created in MYOB.

account_group.name: account_group
account_group.comment: GL account group code. SALES/COGS4 = income; COGS/EXP1/EXADVERT/EXFRE/EXGEN/EXOFFICE/EXTRAVEL/EXPOTH1 = costs. WIP/WIPINC are excluded from this view.

cost_code.name: cost_code
cost_code.comment: Cost code within the project. Used to match against estimated_allowance_value.

account_name.name: account_name
account_name.comment: Resolved customer or supplier name from customer_vendor. Customer name when prefix is C or 2; supplier name when prefix is S.

estimated_allowance_value.name: estimated_allowance_value
estimated_allowance_value.comment: Budgeted/approved allowance amount for this cost code within the project (e.g. a contingency allowance on a specific trade). Pre-aggregated from fin_bills per project+cost_code to prevent fan-out duplication across multiple bill lines.

amount.name: amount
amount.comment: Raw GL amount for the transaction line. Negative = credit/income (standard double-entry). Apply abs() for SALES/COGS4 when calculating revenue.

description.name: description
description.comment: Transaction note from MYOB description_3. Embedded carriage returns/newlines collapsed to spaces. Null when description_3 is blank.

has_stats.label: Has Stats?
has_stats.description: Indicates whether there are statistics for this table

metadata.name: suppliers
metadata.comment: Business-facing suppliers view. One row per MYOB supplier/vendor. Source of truth for supplier financial identities in MYOB. Use vendor_id to join against bills (bills.vendor_id) or project_transactions (customer_vendor where prefix is S). Exposed to Metabase and NLQ.

vendor_id.name: vendor_id
vendor_id.comment: MYOB vendor identifier. Primary join key.

vendor_status.name: vendor_status
vendor_status.comment: Supplier status in MYOB (e.g. Active, Inactive).

last_modified_on.name: last_modified_on
last_modified_on.comment: Timestamp of last modification in MYOB.

created_on.name: created_on
created_on.comment: Timestamp when the supplier record was created in MYOB.

has_stats.label: Has Stats?
has_stats.description: Indicates whether there are statistics for this table
